request.style: English, lament, an old man's cracked and weary voice, slow solo cello and a low drone, a sparse frame drum like a tired heartbeat, D minor, desolate and unresolved, no comfort in the sound, 52 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Let the day perish on which I was born
And the night that said, a boy is conceived
Let that day be darkness
Let no light shine upon it

[Chorus]
Why did I not die at birth
Why did I not breathe my last
Why is light given to the one in misery
Why

[Verse]
Now my life is poured out within me
Days of affliction have taken hold of me
Night pierces my bones
The pains that gnaw me never rest

[Verse]
I cry out to you, and you do not answer
I stand before you, and you only look at me
You lift me up to the wind
You melt me away in the roar of the storm

[Chorus]
Why did I not die at birth
Why did I not breathe my last
Why is light given to the one in misery
Why

[Outro]
I have become like dust and ashes
